About Us

Production
Experience
Partnership
Deployment

  • Presence in over 80 countries represented on our global network

  • 1 million telematics units deployment annually

  • More than 9 million automotive and IoT products and accessories deployed globally

  • More than 300 different products

  • 10 Registered Patents

In addition to ERM’s investment in R&D, designing and developing telematics and connected cars hardware and software technologies and solutions, ERM also manufactures its products in-house and provides the customers with final hardware products.


The production process includes electronic PCB assembly, uploading the embedded software, and packaging to ship. ERM’s quality assurance process monitors each and every sub-process during manufacturing in order to minimize problems and to ensure that the final shipped product meets the highest quality standards.

ERM’s solutions are distributed all over the world thanks to successful collaborations and cooperation with service providers from various fields and businesses in the automotive industry.


By creating fruitful partnerships, we are able to provide our partners with customized solutions for their needs, assisting them to lead their market by offering innovative and tailor-made services. We try to always be there for our partners and to support them with their specific requirements in the shortest time period possible.

ERM’s solutions can be found in over 80 countries, all over the world. With offices in Israel and India, we are able to establish new partnerships and cater to the changing needs of our partners.


At ERM we are always open to new challenges and invest our efforts and resources in making the necessary adjustments, meeting the different requirements and regulations of each country and each partner, and helping our partners to penetrate new markets and expand their businesses by grabbing new opportunities.

eFlash SF

Multi-Functional Driver Alert Solution

eCom

Moving Object monitoring Solution

  • Short-Range Tracking: Tracks within small areas using an eCom Receiver and active Tags.

  • Real-Time Reporting: Tags transmit ID and location based on time, location, or movement.

  • Data Integration: Receiver sends collected data directly to a server.

eMix

Cement Truck Rotation Monitoring Solution

  • Cement Truck Monitoring: Tracks mixer drum rotation and direction with dedicated sensors.

  • Detailed Reporting: Provides data on where, when, and how much cement is unloaded.

  • StarLink Integration: Works seamlessly with StarLink telematics devices for comprehensive insights.

eVoice

Audial Drive Alerts Solution

  • Event-Based Alerts: Delivers pre-recorded or text-to-speech warnings for unsafe driving or location events.

  • Customizable: Supports up to 100 alerts, easily managed via an intuitive app.

  • Fleet Optimization: Enhances driver awareness and safety with real-time notifications.

eCAN

Non-Intrusive CANBUS Read

  • Non-Intrusive Diagnostics: Reads CAN data by simply placing it over CANBUS wires.

  • Custom Alerts: Enables personalized notifications based on CAN parameters.

  • Detailed Reporting: Provides comprehensive insights for vehicle diagnostics.

MagiCAN

Non-Intrusive Simple CANBUS Read

  • Easy Installation: Reads CANBUS parameters via electromagnetic induction, requiring no direct connection.

  • Plug-and-Play: Simply place MagiCAN over CANBUS wires for immediate use.

  • Broad Parameter Access: Enables effortless monitoring of broadcasted CANBUS data.
